body:
I live in Argentina, which happens to be one of the major producers of Yerba Mate, along with the biggest consuming market. Here, Yerba Mate is found as easily as tea.
Firstly, let me state clearly that what you have been drinking is in fact Mate Cocido, not the real Mate. The original infusion consists of a gourd cup called 'Mate', a straw equipped with a filter on one end and a kettle full of water, heated up to about 80 degrees celcius. The gourd is filled with Yerba Mate, and the water is poured into it, and drunk through the straw. This is repeated until the Yerba Mate becomes 'washed' and loses its flavour.
Furthermore, I would like to make a clear point from the fact that I and all of my friends and family drink Mate regularly (every day, in fact) and in large quantities, and no one I know or have heard of never experienced any symptoms even remotely similar to many of those on the web.
